meta.title: Unlock bids "For Everyone"
gaps: Open Settings > Unlock Bids, choose For Everyone, select the OTP recipient, send and submit the OTP, and verify bids are unlocked for all users with event access.
Sign in as a third user with access to the event and verify that user can view vendor responses.
